goal: Allow RPC callers to optionally receive feerates in sat/vB instead of BTC/kvB
Saves modern tooling from manual unit conversions and avoids calculation errors on sub-1 sat/vB rates
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now with no known blockers
agreement: Strong support with all technical objections resolved (musaHaruna, w0xlt)
Concept approval for a backwards-compatible migration to sat/vB (musaHaruna, jonatack)
Approval after resolving floating-point precision, header dependencies, and bucket units (w0xlt)
Warned that default units must never change because doing so would break downstream software (glozow)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because optional sat/vB feerate output is an interface convenience rather than essential core logic
Eases friction for external tooling while remaining fully backwards-compatible for existing consumers
